academic_boundary: These are prospective proposals, not retroactive method definitions or evidence of performance.

ledger_hardening_protocol.candidate_cap_policy: record work already spent on generation; reject unique-state expansion without kernel call, state mutation, or expansion event
ledger_hardening_protocol.queue_binding: nonempty frozen queue plus successful schema-audit digest
ledger_hardening_protocol.segment_lifecycle: unique attempt IDs, contiguous per-item ordinals, rollback may retry, exactly one terminal segment per queue item, and no attempt after terminal
ledger_hardening_protocol.sha256_validation: lowercase 64-hex for IDs, roots, implementations, and artifacts

magnitude_control.acceptance_and_rollback: use the request-bound optimizer and acceptance policy; failed acceptance rolls back state, ansatz, resources, and optimizer state before termination
magnitude_control.approval_consequence: not executable until exact wording and digest are approved
magnitude_control.cap_rule: record work already performed; do not execute an operation that would exceed cap
magnitude_control.physical_rule: delete the physical generator, then perform a full resource recount
magnitude_control.score: squared constraint residual from the pinned parent calibration semantics
magnitude_control.selection: remove the lowest score; ties break by lowercase structural candidate ID
magnitude_control.sequential_rule: after each committed deletion, reoptimize the remaining ansatz and recompute all surviving scores from the committed child before considering another deletion
magnitude_control.stale_rule: pre-deletion scores become invalid after every commit or rollback
stopping: the next deletion is rejected by the frozen acceptance policy
the next operation would exceed the componentwise work cap

no_rebuild.approval_consequence: not executable until exact wording and digest are approved
no_rebuild.causal_contrast: full V5 may regenerate its structural candidate set after each accepted child; no-rebuild freezes the source structural whitelist and source order
child_rebinding: recompute numerical constraints, predictions, curvature coordinates, and resources
bar every candidate absent from the source whitelist
no_rebuild.ordering_rule: preserve frozen source order; current numerical values never rerank
no_rebuild.round_rule: use the parent V5 acceptance, commit, reoptimization, rollback, and stopping policies, but never replenish or expand the structural whitelist
no_rebuild.stale_rule: a whitelisted structural ID absent or semantically incompatible in the current catalog is STALE_UNAVAILABLE, is recorded, and is never executed

v4_1_h2_h4_sentinel.authorization_boundary: an approved protocol still does not authorize energy; a separate audited H2/H4 queue freeze and pre-calibration gate are required
v4_1_h2_h4_sentinel.historical_rule: historical V4.1 sentinels may be provenance evidence only and may not be copied
v4_1_h2_h4_sentinel.scope: H2/H4 calibration only; separate from the 90-item development queue
screening_inputs_allowed: structural candidate identity and equivalence class
predeclared work, optimizer, acceptance, RNG, and environment policies

systems_boundary: No executable authorization can be derived while approval_record is empty.
